vendorDefects.reason: On the #171 x86-64 VM the pinned vendor engine (sky_linux_x64, under cua's own host, the only one Linux serves) answers typeText with `editable Paste did not insert text` after its 10 s EditableText.PasteText attempt; gedit (GTK 3) survives and the marker never reaches the text. The case's oracle encodes arm64's outcome (the NoReply or EAGAIN error, then the window's exit), so the x64 failure is recorded vendor behaviour, not passing coverage (docs/doperpowers/specs/2026-10-28-own-linux-engine-design.md, Surprises & Discoveries: the text-case oracles accept only arm64's outcomes). M2 replaces the oracle with a positive one.
